wrap.axis_why: a pistol grip is wrapped around its own long axis, which runs up toward the bore; MEANING_PLAN Step 3 says 'against the bore', which is across a pistol grip (flagged to the owner)
wrap.rule: MEANING_PLAN Step 3: the fingers curl around the gun's side toward the far side, and the thumb closes from the other side
wrap.sign_why: right hand: a finger runs forward across the front strap, then toward the left side: forward x left = +up. The thumb runs forward along the left side, then in toward the gun (-left): forward x -left = -up
wrap.min_curl_why: a digit whose summed bend is under 0.2 (about 12 deg in all) has no curl to read and fails
